summary_for_children: Al-Jathiyah means The Kneeling. It shows how Allah made the sea and everything in the heavens and earth useful for people, as signs for those who think.
environment_concept: Ships sailing (45:12) and a wide view of sky and land, with birds and grazing animals (45:13).
architecture_and_scenery: Busy sea lanes, fishing boats, a sky with orderly winds and an endless shore.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A grassy headland between the sea, a line of hills, a palm grove and a small town, with a weather station on top

primary_mechanic.text: Keep the field ledger through one day: at morning, noon and evening, read the wind vane (it points into the wind, toward one of four landmarks) and the rain gauge yourself and write them down; wrong entries are refused. The light, the wind and the rain change after each reading (45:5).

secondary_activities: signs in the heavens and the earth (45:3-5, read)
the sea and the ships (45:12-13, read)
unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading by the palms, three ledger readings through the day, then the sea and the record
world_assets: hills, palm grove and town as landmarks
environment_behaviour: the vane turns to the new wind after each reading
the gauge fills with the rain that falls
the sky goes from morning to noon to dusk
rain falls at noon and evening
unique_world.learning_objective: Read the signs of wind, rain and the day yourself (45:5)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: The Book of Our Actions
story_library.children_narration: Every day, we make choices. Some choices help others, while some can cause harm. The Quran reminds us that our actions matter and that Allah knows what we do. It also invites us to reflect on the signs around us: the wind, rain, and changing day and night.

world_idea.title: The Gallery of Choices
world_idea.description: Explore an interactive book of fictional everyday decisions and see how acts of kindness affect a community. Do not claim to portray the actual records of deeds or the Day of Judgment.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
